main_result_summary: A genuine physical square changes the determinant-envelope integrability threshold from k>2q for direct L1 inversion to k>q for bounded density: ||p_Q||inf <= H_{k,q}|d|^-1/2 E_k(B)^(-1/(4k)). In particular q=2,k=3 is leverage-free. Named partner paving then improves localized exact-rank-three constants to <16.492 for mu<1/8, <38.408 for mu<=1/6, and <75.879 for mu<=0.18.
fresh_correction_result_summary: For independent X,U with cap(X)<=1, cap(U)<=M, T=2a XU+h(X) has ||p_T||2<=2 sqrt(M/|a|). Two disjoint such packets give ||phi||1<=8pi sqrt(M1M2/(|ab|)) and density<=4 sqrt(M1M2/(|ab|)). This uniformly closes the entire five-coordinate family used by QFORM-O1-PIVOT-SCALE-FROM-MASS-FALSE-v1, including epsilon=0.
unresolved_implication: Above the s2(A-diag A)<=0.499 branch, extract from O1/O2/O3 aggregate third-compound mass either a nonzero-pivot square-assisted Ek resource or two disjoint aggregate hyperbolic packets, preserving original product provenance. Do not infer pivot scale from O1 mass or rank-two cross cuts from high offdiagonal s2.
next_step: Build an inverse-free exterior-algebra coloring lemma for O1/O2 mass that outputs two disjoint linear aggregate banks with dimension-free one-dimensional density caps, then apply QFORM-AFFINE-HYPERBOLIC-L2-v1 via L2xL2 Fourier Cauchy-Schwarz.
